texts.Description:SceneId: The Scene Id for the verification code scenario, obtained in the console.
texts.Description:Prefix: Obtain it in the instance basic information card area of the console overview page.
texts.Description:UseEncryptedSceneId: This mode can effectively prevent service theft or malicious invocation caused by the leakage of sceneId.
texts.Description:EKey: The encrypted key can be obtained in the upper right area of the console overview page. It is the key used for encryption (ekey).
texts.Description:EncryptedExpireTimeSec: The valid duration of the encrypted string (in seconds, with a range of 1 to 86400, which is from 1 second to 24 hours).
